messages:
Priya (VP Infra): quick all-hands follow-up 99about regional GPU capacity, burst/fallback, and a couple of clarifications from the Q&A. ask short q's here and well reply.

Sam (Infra PM): is the burst capacity pre-provisioned or pulled from a shared pool when needed?

Priya (VP Infra): hybrid: small pre-warmed pool in critical zones + shared regional reserve that can be reprovisioned within ~60-90s.

Rosa (SRE): curious about blackout scenarios  if an entire region degrades, do we fail requests or route to the nearest region automatically?

Priya (VP Infra): automatic failover to fallback regions up to two hops. for ultra-sensitive customers we provide Dedicated pinning to avoid cross-region routing.

Arjun (Capacity): sharing the conservative autoscaler profile we demoed:
```
min_zone: 1
warm_pool: 2
scale_step: 1
cooldown_s: 180
burst_threshold: 0.9
```

Tom (Platform): does priming traffic count toward autoscale triggers? saw a spike during priming yesterday.

Arjun (Capacity): were adding a priming tag so autoscaler ignores priming traffic up to 6% of capacity.

Leah (Finance): rough monthly delta for keeping 2 warm nodes in a zone vs pure on-demand? need a ballpark for budgeting.

Priya (VP Infra): ballpark: ~$6-9k/month per APAC zone (depends on SKU). Tom will run exact sims and post.

Rosa (SRE): rollover/rollback question: if a canary triggers rollback, is the previous version immediately re-enabled?

Priya (VP Infra): yes for critical thresholds (error-rate >5% or latency >2x SLA) rollback is immediate. non-critical signals go to manual review.

Sam (Infra PM): H100 timing for Dedicated? several customers asked.

Arjun (Capacity): partners expect H100 next quarter; Dedicated opt-in ~4-6 weeks after arrival for safety/telemetry checks.

Tom (Platform): we should add a Console flag for models that are allowed in warm pools (some quantized/custom-kernel models need longer startup).

Priya (VP Infra): agreed  will add model-eligibility flag in the catalog and short doc blurb.

Rosa (SRE): action item: add dashboard annotation for priming windows so ops doesn't misinterpret spikes.

Arjun (Capacity): noted  will add annotation + priming tag this week.

Leah (Finance): action: Tom to publish cost sims by Friday.

Tom (Platform): acked  will post spreadsheet and grant access to finance/infra.

Priya (VP Infra): actions recap: 1) Tom: cost sims by Fri. 2) Arjun: priming tag + dashboard annotation. 3) Priya/Sam: model-eligibility flag & doc. will fold into all-hands notes.

autoscale-bot: scheduled: "region-fallback-test" started (job-id: test-193123).

Rosa (SRE): cool thread, thanks. small follow-ups ping me here; larger items open ticket in #eng-oncall.

Priya (VP Infra): thanks everyone  closing after actions are tracked.
